head_coach.name: Didier Deschamps
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly organized, pragmatic, and defensively solid approach utilizing a strong double pivot in midfield. Focuses on structured defensive blocks combined with vertical, direct counter-attacks that exploit the world-class speed, technical ability, and creativity of the attacking wingers and forwards.

key_players.name: Kylian Mbappé
key_players.performance_stats: Averages 1.05 goals per game across all competitions in the 2025/26 season, registering 38 goals and 6 assists in 36 matches for Real Madrid. Retains a 91 overall EA FC 26 rating and recently matched Cristiano Ronaldo's record of 59 goals in a calendar year.

key_players.name: Ousmane Dembélé
key_players.performance_stats: Voted Transfermarkt's Ligue 1 Player of the Season for 2025/26 after recording 10 goals and 7 assists in 22 matches for PSG. Famously won the 2025 Ballon d'Or after contributing 35 goals and 14 assists in 53 appearances the previous year.

key_players.name: Michael Olise
key_players.performance_stats: Voted Bundesliga's Player of the Season for 2025/26 after contributing 15 goals and 19 assists in 32 matches for Bayern Munich, becoming the first player since 2019/20 to record 15+ goals and assists in a single Bundesliga campaign. He achieved an 8.09 average FotMob rating.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruptured Achilles tendon sustained in April 2026 during a UEFA Champions League quarterfinal match against Paris Saint-Germain, ruling him out of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Excluded from the 26-man FIFA World Cup squad by manager Didier Deschamps following an injury-plagued and inconsistent club season with Real Madrid where he struggled for regular playing time.
